identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.
anti_patterns: No 'Inter' for headings - use Manrope for character.
No excessive gradients - use them for focus only.

theme_strategy.logic: Light mode for day-shift clarity and hygiene perception. Dark mode for night-shift comfort.

headings.usage: All page titles, card headers, and modal titles. Use 'text-slate-900' in light mode.

body.usage: Data tables, descriptions, inputs. Optimized for density and legibility.

mono.usage: Room numbers, reservation IDs, API keys.

primary.description: Deep Slate Navy. Used for Sidebars, Primary Headings, Strong Borders. Represents Authority and Luxury.

brand_accent.description: Emerald Green. Used for Primary Actions (Check-in, Save), Success States, and Revenue metrics. Represents Freshness and Calm.

secondary_accent.description: Warm Amber. Used for 'Pending' states, Warnings, and Attention checks (e.g., 'Room Cleaning Required').

buttons.primary: bg-brand-accent hover:bg-brand-accent-hover text-white rounded-md font-medium px-6 py-2 transition-all shadow-sm hover:shadow-md active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-900 rounded-md font-medium px-6 py-2 transition-all
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 rounded-md px-4 py-2

cards.base: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm p-6 transition-all hover:border-slate-300

inputs.style: bg-white border-slate-200 focus:border-brand-accent focus:ring-brand-accent rounded-md h-10 px-3

icons.usage: Use consistent stroke width. Color matches text color usually.

ai_features.visual_identity: Use a subtle gradient border (purple-to-blue) for AI-generated content. Use a 'Sparkles' icon.

rules: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text.
All interactive elements must have aria-labels if icon-only.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic 'blue' (#3b82f6) for primary actions - use the Brand Emerald.
Do not center-align dashboard widgets text - keep it left-aligned for scannability.
Use 'Manrope' font for all Headings (h1-h6). Import it from Google Fonts.
